title: Opening a Bank Account
meta: B2 · 约 260 词 · 场景：银行开户材料与账户选择

lines.en: Hi, thanks for waiting. What can I do for you today?
lines.zh: 你好，久等了。今天办什么业务？

lines.en: **I'd like to open a savings account. I've just moved here for work.**
lines.zh: 我想开一个储蓄账户。我刚来这边工作。

lines.en: Welcome. Are you after a basic account, or one that pays more ==interest== if your salary goes in?
lines.zh: 欢迎。您想要普通账户，还是工资打进来就能拿更高利息的那种？

lines.en: My salary will go in here, so the second one. Is there a ==minimum balance==?
lines.zh: 我工资会打到这里，所以要第二种。有最低余额要求吗？

lines.en: Yes, three thousand dollars on average each month. If you __fall below__ that, there's a ==fee== of five dollars.
lines.zh: 有，每月平均余额三千元。低于这个数，收五块钱手续费。

lines.en: Okay, that's manageable. Does it __come with__ a debit card I can use overseas?
lines.zh: 好，这个能接受。账户带一张能在国外用的借记卡吗？

lines.en: It does, and you can lock it or change your limits in the app.
lines.zh: 带的，而且可以在手机应用里锁卡或者改额度。

lines.en: Great. What documents do you need from me?
lines.zh: 好。需要我提供哪些材料？

lines.en: Your passport, your ==work pass==, and a ==proof of address== from the last three months.
lines.zh: 您的护照、工作准证，还有近三个月内的住址证明。

lines.en: Here's my passport and work pass. For the address, I have my tenancy agreement.
lines.zh: 这是我的护照和工作准证。住址证明我带了租约。

lines.en: Hmm, this lease is only in your wife's name, so I can't __accept it__ for you, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 嗯，这份租约上只有您太太的名字，很遗憾不能作为您的证明。

lines.en: **I see. What else would work? We only moved in last month.**
lines.zh: 明白了。那还有什么可以用？我们上个月才搬进来。

lines.en: A ==utility bill== or a letter from your employer with your address would be fine.
lines.zh: 水电账单，或者公司开的、写有您地址的信都可以。

lines.en: My company can send a letter today. Could I __email it over__ instead of coming back?
lines.zh: 公司今天就能开信。我能直接发邮件给你，不用再跑一趟吗？

lines.en: Unfortunately we need to see the ==original==, but you can upload it in the app once you're ==verified==.
lines.zh: 很遗憾我们需要看原件，不过等您身份核验好后，可以在应用里上传。

lines.en: So can we start the application now and finish it later?
lines.zh: 那我们能先把申请办起来，之后再补材料吗？

lines.en: Yes. I'll set everything up today, and the account goes live once your letter is uploaded.
lines.zh: 可以。今天我把其他都办好，您上传信件后账户就能启用。

lines.en: **That works. How long does the card take to arrive?**
lines.zh: 这样可以。卡多久能寄到？

lines.en: About five working days, posted to your home address.
lines.zh: 大约五个工作日，寄到您家里。

gist.q: 「你」选了哪种账户？最低余额规则是什么？
gist.a: 工资入账可拿更高利息的账户；月平均余额要三千元，低于就收五元手续费。

gist.q: 开户材料哪里出了问题？
gist.a: 租约上只有太太的名字，不能当「你」的住址证明。
今天先办申请，等公司开出写有地址的信后在应用里上传，账户就能启用。

prompts.q: 你想给孩子开一个儿童储蓄账户。去银行柜台问需要哪些材料、有没有最低余额、孩子长大后怎么转到他自己名下。
prompts.ref: Hi, I'd like to open a savings account for my son. He's three. What documents do you need, his birth certificate and my passport? Is there a minimum balance for kids' accounts? And when he's older, can the account be moved into his own name, or would he need to open a new one?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我想给儿子开个储蓄账户，他三岁。需要哪些材料？他的出生证明和我的护照吗？儿童账户有最低余额要求吗？等他长大了，这个账户能转到他自己名下吗，还是得重新开一个？

prompts.q: 你的账户上个月被扣了低于最低余额的手续费，但你觉得自己一直存够了。打电话给银行问清楚并请求退回。
prompts.ref: Hi, I noticed a fall-below fee on my account last month, and I don't quite understand why. I've kept more than three thousand in there the whole time. Could you check how the average balance was worked out? If it's a mistake, could you reverse the fee? If not, I'd just like to understand the rule better.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我发现上个月账户被扣了一笔低于最低余额的费用，不太明白为什么。我账户里一直都有三千以上。能帮我查一下平均余额是怎么算的吗？如果算错了，能把费用退回吗？如果没错，我也想把规则弄清楚。

words.ex: This account pays very little interest.
Keep the minimum balance or you'll be charged a fee.
Is there a fee for using other banks' ATMs?
Bring your work pass when you sign the lease.
A phone bill can be used as proof of address.
Our utility bill went up because of the aircon.
You need to verify your identity with your passport.
Please bring the original and one photocopy.
If your balance falls below the limit, you'll get an alert.
Read the tenancy agreement carefully before you sign.
